text:
anya: Quick heads-up — after yesterday's model-family rename, the scorecard UI is blaming the wrong alias for a latency/regression spike. https://dashboard.redwood.ai/scorecard/abc :eyes:

mike: repro steps?

anya: go to Scorecard > latency > timeframe: 03/18; filter by rollout=canary. The top offender shows model alias 'rwdx-v2' but the traces point to 'rwdx-v2-quant' variants.

oliver: sounds like the onboarding pipeline kept old alias mapping in metric tags.

eval-runner-bot: Run 5872 completed: ingest labels applied: model_alias=rwdx-v2 (expected=rwdx-v2-quant)

mike: can you paste the ingest config that assigns model_alias?

anya: payload excerpt:
```
metadata: { model_id: "rwdx-42", family_alias: "rwdx-v2-quant", alias: "rwdx-v2" }
```

anya: looks like alias is being picked from family_alias fallback, not the normalized alias field.

oliver: I think this is the legacy mapping in eval-ingest: normalize_alias(family_alias) when alias missing. We recently renamed families so the fallback is stale.

tara: we should add a unit test for alias normalization and gate it in CI. I can own the test.

mike: I'll open a small fix PR to prefer explicit alias, then fallback to family_alias only if alias empty. Will include a migration to rehydrate alias tag for recent runs.

ci-bot: PR #1219 checks failed on lint — please run `pre-commit`.

anya: after a quick patch locally, dashboard now shows correct attribution in the drilldown. I'll post a before/after screenshot in thread.

oliver: add an eval-runner audit to reprocess runs from 03/15-03/19 to update tags.

tara: also add a regression alert to not trigger on alias-only drift — the mapping change shouldn't create false positives.

mike: noted. creating PR and CI job. ETA EOD.

anya: thanks all :thumbsup:
